fields.name: company
fields.semantic: Full name of the company issuing the IPO.

contamination_risks.description: Value may be a number formatted with Indian commas (e.g., '1,23,456') or a placeholder '-'. Could be a string representation of a number.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Parse as integer after stripping commas; treat '-' as null.

contamination_risks.description: Units are shares, but magnitude may be in lakhs/crores; ensure consistent scaling.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Assume raw number of shares; do not scale.

fields.name: cumQty
fields.semantic: Cumulative quantity of bids received, displayed as a string. Currently placeholder '-'.

contamination_risks.description: May be a number formatted as string, possibly with Indian number format or currency symbol.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Parse as decimal after removing currency symbols and commas; treat '-' as null.

contamination_risks.description: Value is in INR, but may be in paise or rupees; check for decimal places.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Assume INR with two decimal places; if no decimal, treat as whole rupees.

fields.name: price
fields.semantic: Price band or current price for the IPO, displayed as a string. Currently placeholder '-'.

contamination_risks.description: Symbol may be reused across different securities (e.g., same symbol for different series).
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Combine with exchange and series for uniqueness.

fields.name: symbol
fields.notes: Used as key to join with other endpoints.
fields.semantic: Ticker symbol of the company on the stock exchange.

contamination_risks.description: May be in 'dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm' format or placeholder '-'. Timezone likely IST.
contamination_risks.suggested_mitigation: Parse with known format; treat '-' as null; assume IST and convert to UTC.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.semantic: Timestamp of the data snapshot, displayed as a string. Currently placeholder '-'.
